html:
It’s April, and here in South Florida it’s starting to feel like summer. But thanks to a former Seedling, we’ve managed to capture one last bit of winter magic before it melts away in memory.

The following is an audio story about Sunflower’s annual building of a giant Castle made of Ice and what participation means to the members of our community.

Listen. Can you see it?
